blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 SINGAPORE–Junmilardo Ogayre punched his ticket to the men’s 60-kilogram boxing quarterfinal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Friday at Nishio Gymnasium in Japan. Ogayre inched closer to the medal rounds after a convincing win over Nepal’s Khagendra Roka Magar in the round of 16.
